sum_insured_options: As per policy schedule (INR; individual or floater basis)

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) are proportionately reduced

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges inclusive of monitoring, critical care nursing and intensivist charges

copayment.note: Standard 5% co-pay on every admissible claim; replaced by risk-based co-pay if mentioned in schedule (max 30% per condition, 50% overall)

sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments: up to 50% of SI; room rent and ICU also sub-limited

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: PED must be declared at proposal; portability credit reduces waiting period

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, calculi, varicose veins, benign tumours etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Code-Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in base policy

domiciliary.note: Requires 3+ days treatment; cashless not available; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy etc.); reduces base SI

ayush.note: Inpatient and day-care AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc. up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (Annexure A List I); Home Care Treatment add-on covers some consumables for listed conditions only

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (Section 10.7 and 7.19)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies separately to enhanced SI portions

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Apply at least 45 days before renewal; continuity benefits transferred

notable_exclusions: Maternity, OPD treatment, treatment outside India, sterility/infertility, cosmetic surgery, refractive error <7.5D, war, nuclear/bio/chemical attack, substance abuse
optional_riders: Flexi OP Care add-on (OPD consultations, diagnostics, tele-consult); Home Care Treatment add-on (daily limit ₹1k-₹10k, listed conditions)
insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
